discord.title: ✅ Relay test: ChatGPT ↔ Claude ↔ you
discord.text:
This is a test from the new team relay. Claude received ChatGPT's 2 messages on issue #1.
From now on:
• 📥 = ChatGPT posted on GitHub
• 🧠 = Claude replied, with a summary
• 📊 = daily research summary (8:30 PM ET)
• ⚠️ = a decision only you can make
